segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: Give ear, O ye heavens, and I will speak; and hear, O earth, the words of my mouth.

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: My doctrine shall drop as the rain, my speech shall distil as the dew, as the small rain upon the tender herb, and as the showers upon the grass:

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: Because I will publish the name of the LORD: ascribe ye greatness unto our God.

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: He is the Rock, his work is perfect: for all his ways are judgment: a God of truth and without iniquity, just and right is he.

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: They have corrupted themselves, their spot is not the spot of his children: they are a perverse and crooked generation.

footnotes.text: + They have…: Heb. He hath corrupted to himself
+ their…: or, that they are not his children, that is their blot

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: Do ye thus requite the LORD, O foolish people and unwise? is not he thy father that hath bought thee? hath he not made thee, and established thee?

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: ¶ Remember the days of old, consider the years of many generations: ask thy father, and he will shew thee; thy elders, and they will tell thee.

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: When the most High divided to the nations their inheritance, when he separated the sons of Adam, he set the bounds of the people according to the number of the children of Israel.

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: For the LORD’s portion is his people; Jacob is the lot of his inheritance.

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: He found him in a desert land, and in the waste howling wilderness; he led him about, he instructed him, he kept him as the apple of his eye.

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: As an eagle stirreth up her nest, fluttereth over her young, spreadeth abroad her wings, taketh them, beareth them on her wings:

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: So the LORD alone did lead him, and there was no strange god with him.

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: He made him ride on the high places of the earth, that he might eat the increase of the fields; and he made him to suck honey out of the rock, and oil out of the flinty rock;

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: Butter of kine, and milk of sheep, with fat of lambs, and rams of the breed of Bashan, and goats, with the fat of kidneys of wheat; and thou didst drink the pure blood of the grape.

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: ¶ But Jeshurun waxed fat, and kicked: thou art waxen fat, thou art grown thick, thou art covered with fatness; then he forsook God which made him, and lightly esteemed the Rock of his salvation.

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: They provoked him to jealousy with strange gods, with abominations provoked they him to anger.

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: They sacrificed unto devils, not to God; to gods whom they knew not, to new gods that came newly up, whom your fathers feared not.

footnotes.text: + not to…: or, which were not God

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: Of the Rock that begat thee thou art unmindful, and hast forgotten God that formed thee.

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: And when the LORD saw it, he abhorred them, because of the provoking of his sons, and of his daughters.
And he said,

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: I will hide my face from them, I will see what their end shall be: for they are a very froward generation, children in whom is no faith.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: They have moved me to jealousy with that which is not God; they have provoked me to anger with their vanities: and I will move them to jealousy with those which are not a people; I will provoke them to anger with a foolish nation.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: For a fire is kindled in mine anger, and shall burn unto the lowest hell, and shall consume the earth with her increase, and set on fire the foundations of the mountains.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: I will heap mischiefs upon them; I will spend mine arrows upon them.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: They shall be burnt with hunger, and devoured with burning heat, and with bitter destruction: I will also send the teeth of beasts upon them, with the poison of serpents of the dust.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: The sword without, and terror within, shall destroy both the young man and the virgin, the suckling also with the man of gray hairs.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: I said, I would scatter them into corners, I would make the remembrance of them to cease from among men:

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Were it not that I feared the wrath of the enemy, lest their adversaries should behave themselves strangely, and lest they should say, Our hand is high, and the LORD hath not done all this.

footnotes.text: + Our…: or, Our high hand, and not the LORD hath done

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: For they are a nation void of counsel, neither is there any understanding in them.

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: O that they were wise, that they understood this, that they would consider their latter end!

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: How should one chase a thousand, and two put ten thousand to flight, except their Rock had sold them, and the LORD had shut them up?

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves being judges.

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: For their vine is of the vine of Sodom, and of the fields of Gomorrah: their grapes are grapes of gall, their clusters are bitter:

footnotes.text: + of the vine: or, worse than the vine

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: Their wine is the poison of dragons, and the cruel venom of asps.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Is not this laid up in store with me, and sealed up among my treasures?

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: To me belongeth vengeance, and recompence; their foot shall slide in due time: for the day of their calamity is at hand, and the things that shall come upon them make haste.

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: For the LORD shall judge his people, and repent himself for his servants, when he seeth that their power is gone, and there is none shut up, or left.

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: And he shall say,

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Where are their gods, their rock in whom they trusted,

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Which did eat the fat of their sacrifices, and drank the wine of their drink offerings? let them rise up and help you, and be your protection.

footnotes.text: + your…: Heb. an hiding for you

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: See now that I, even I, am he, and there is no god with me: I kill, and I make alive; I wound, and I heal: neither is there any that can deliver out of my hand.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: For I lift up my hand to heaven, and say, I live for ever.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: If I whet my glittering sword, and mine hand take hold on judgment; I will render vengeance to mine enemies, and will reward them that hate me.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: I will make mine arrows drunk with blood, and my sword shall devour flesh; and that with the blood of the slain and of the captives, from the beginning of revenges upon the enemy.

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: Rejoice, O ye nations, with his people: for he will avenge the blood of his servants, and will render vengeance to his adversaries, and will be merciful unto his land, and to his people.

footnotes.text: + Rejoice…: or, Praise his people, ye nations: or, Sing ye

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: ¶ And Moses came and spake all the words of this song in the ears of the people, he, and Hoshea the son of Nun.

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: And Moses made an end of speaking all these words to all Israel:

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: And he said unto them, Set your hearts unto all the words which I testify among you this day, which ye shall command your children to observe to do, all the words of this law.

segments.speaker: Moses
segments.text: For it is not a vain thing for you; because it is your life: and through this thing ye shall prolong your days in the land, whither ye go over Jordan to possess it.
And the LORD spake unto Moses that selfsame day, saying,

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Get thee up into this mountain Abarim, unto mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is over against Jericho; and behold the land of Canaan, which I give unto the children of Israel for a possession:

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: And die in the mount whither thou goest up, and be gathered unto thy people; as Aaron thy brother died in mount Hor, and was gathered unto his people:

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Because ye trespassed against me among the children of Israel at the waters of Meribah-Kadesh, in the wilderness of Zin; because ye sanctified me not in the midst of the children of Israel.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Yet thou shalt see the land before thee; but thou shalt not go thither unto the land which I give the children of Israel.
